abstract: Fetus in Fetu (FIF) is a rare condition where a monozygotic diamnionic parasitic twin is incorporated into the body of its fellow twin and grows inside it. FIF is differentiated from teratoma by the presence of vertebral column. An eight year old girl presented with an abdominal swelling which by X-ray, ultrasonography and CT scan revealed a fetiform mass containing long bones and vertebral bodies surrounded by soft tissue situated on right lumber region. On laparotomy, a retroperitoneal mass resembling a fetus of 585 gm was removed. It had a trunk and four limbs with fingers and toes, umbilical stump, intestinal loops and abundant scalp hairs but was devoid of brain and heart. Histology showed various well-differentiated tissues in respective sites. FIF is a mystery in reproduction and it is scarce in literature in such well-developed stage.
abstract_ja: 胎児内胎児(FIF)は稀な病態で、一卵性の二羊膜性寄生双胎が、その双子の片割れの体内に取り込まれて成長するものである。FIFは椎体の有無によって奇形腫と区別される。8歳の女児が腹部膨隆を訴えて受診した。X線、超音波検査、CTで、右腰部に長管骨と椎体を含み、軟部組織に囲まれた胎児様の腫瘤が認められた。開腹術で、四肢、指趾、臍帯断端、腸管ループ、豊富な頭髪を備えた585gの胎児様後腹膜腫瘤を摘出した。脳と心臓は欠如していた。組織学的検査では、各部位に分化した様々な組織が認められた。FIFは生殖医学における謎であり、これほど発達した段階の症例は文献上稀である。
